items.title: Why Did the Dow Hit a New Record Today?
items.summary: The Dow Jones Industrial Average hit a new record today for the first time in nearly a month. It was the 22nd record close for the blue-chip average this year. Here were some of the biggest gainers in the index today.

items.title: Iran war pushes companies to raise prices on beer, paint and fries
items.summary: Investing.com -- The closure of the Strait of Hormuz during the Iran war is prompting companies to raise prices on products including beer, paint, french fries and packaging as commodity and transport costs climb, the Wall Street Journal reported.

items.title: Why the Dow Is Having an Especially Bad Day
items.summary: The stock market was a sea of red Wednesday, but the Dow was having an especially bad day. The Dow Jones Industrial Average fell 922 points, or 1.8%. The S&P 500 fell 1.1%. The Nasdaq Composite was down 1.
